notes: Model pilot (haiku arm; the same pole is tested independently by the other arm, pairing disclosed): this pole feeds the held pole bonsai1/L35/N4245- (zeroing this neuron removes 0.87 of the anchor's peak), from a batched edge measurement with 8 same-layer placebos. Label and all 16 sentences written by the Haiku 5.5 labeller from a packet (card + all-pole band samples + the edge hint) and one probe round of 8 sentences (none reused). An Opus gate checked rule-level items only and edited nothing. Labeller's note: Probes: none of the meaning-only sentences (lingo, parlance, shop talk, esoteric vocabulary) reached 0.3; the strongest was 'parlance' at 0.21 on its ' parl' piece. So the pole tracks the word jargon (its ' j' token), not the meaning alone. The ' j' in jacket and jury stayed near zero, and the near misses here use the specialist topic without the word.
